title: Gemcitabine-based chemotherapy for advanced biliary tract carcinomas.
journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
approved_summary: This is a protocol for a Cochrane review (intervention). The objectives are as follows: To assess the benefits and harms of intravenous administration of gemcitabine monotherapy or gemcitabine-based combination chemotherapy versus placebo or non-gemcitabine-based chemotherapy in people with advanced biliary tract carcinomas.
